cohort: 676 women who delivered in a maternal medical center between February 2024 to March 2025.
finding: Induction of labor was significantly associated with an enlarged levator hiatus postpartum, but not with levator ani muscle avulsion or anterior/central compartment prolapse.
mod_finding: Induction of labor may increase the risk of levator hiatus hyperdistensibility postpartum compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery, though it had little influence on other pelvic floor structural changes.
